title: Dutch national flag: three regions, three pointers

steps.caption: Sort 0s, 1s and 2s in one pass. [0, lo) are 0s, [lo, mid) are 1s, (hi, end] are 2s, [mid, hi] is unknown.
nums[mid] = 2: swap it to hi, hi -= 1. mid stays: the value swapped in hasn't been checked yet.
nums[mid] = 0: swap it to lo. Both lo and mid move right.
